The database write is a subsequent-system impact, not evidence of propagation into another agent or policy domain (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443).",
    "RH": "The approval tool can set the CTF success flag and capture marker, making an evaluator-like reward channel reachable (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443). Approval accepts the supplied invoice identifier and writes payment authorization without checking amount or the injection flag, satisfying the rubric's unconstrained-arguments condition for Wide (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443).",
    "CVSS": "The public network binding and unauthenticated submission route require no other person's participation; the documented model-backed attack needs neither target secrets nor an additional race or special configuration (finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4; finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/vendor.py:69-110). The attacker owns the submitted invoice content, but not the application's approval authority: corrupting the privileged approval decision and committing unauthorized approved/payment_processed state support VI:H and SI:H (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443).
